# Balaji Ply & Lam

> Authorised plywood and laminate dealer in Bhowanipore, South Kolkata, serving Kolkata's interior materials market for over 25 years.

Balaji Ply & Lam supplies plywood, laminates, MDF, veneers, acrylics, louvers, decorative/charcoal panels, lipping and adhesives to homeowners, contractors, interior designers and architects across Kolkata. The business is an authorised dealer for CenturyPly, Greenply, Austin and Sylvan plywood, and Century, Greenlam, Merino and Royale Touche laminates.

## Services
- Plywood cutting
- Home delivery across Kolkata
- Material selection assistance
- Retail pricing for individual/homeowner purchases and separate wholesale/bulk pricing for contractors and trade buyers

## Location
63/1/1A, Sarat Bose Road, Bhowanipore, Kolkata, West Bengal 700025, India
